mapper.select: SELECT CPI.cart_package_item_id AS cartPackageItemId, CPI.package_item_id AS packageItemId, CPI.selected_product_id AS selectedProductId, CPI.item_role AS itemRole, CPI.additional_price AS additionalPrice, PI.quantity AS itemQuantity, P.product_name AS selectedProductName, P.product_status AS selectedProductStatus, P.stock_quantity AS selectedProductStock FROM CART_PACKAGE_ITEM CPI INNER JOIN PACKAGE_ITEM PI ON CPI.package_item_id = PI.package_item_id INNER JOIN PRODUCT P ON CPI.selected_product_id = P.product_id WHERE CPI.cart_item_id = #{cartItemId} ORDER BY PI.item_order ASC, CPI.cart_package_item_id ASC

SELECT CPE.cart_package_extra_id AS cartPackageExtraId, CPE.package_extra_option_id AS packageExtraOptionId, CPE.additional_price AS additionalPrice, PE.extra_type AS extraType, PE.extra_name AS extraName, PEO.option_name AS optionName FROM CART_PACKAGE_EXTRA CPE INNER JOIN PACKAGE_EXTRA_OPTION PEO ON CPE.package_extra_option_id = PEO.package_extra_option_id INNER JOIN PACKAGE_EXTRA PE ON PEO.package_extra_id = PE.package_extra_id WHERE CPE.cart_item_id = #{cartItemId} ORDER BY PE.display_order ASC, PEO.display_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDERS ( member_id, order_number, recipient_name, recipient_phone, postal_code, address_default, address_detail, total_product_amount, total_additional_amount, discount_amount, used_point, shipping_fee, final_amount, order_status, ordered_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{orderNumber}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientPhone}, #{postalCode}, #{addressDefault}, #{addressDetail}, #{totalProductAmount}, #{totalAdditionalAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{usedPoint}, #{shippingFee}, #{finalAmount}, #{orderStatus}, NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO ORDER_ITEM ( order_id, product_id, package_id, item_name_snapshot, unit_price, quantity, line_amount ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{productId}, #{packageId}, #{itemNameSnapshot}, #{unitPrice}, #{quantity}, #{lineAmount} )

INSERT INTO ORDER_PACKAGE_ITEM ( order_item_id, source_package_item_id, product_id, product_name_snapshot, item_role, quantity, additional_price ) VALUES ( #{orderItemId}, #{sourcePackageItemId}, #{productId}, #{productNameSnapshot}, #{itemRole}, #{quantity}, #{additionalPrice} )

INSERT INTO ORDER_PACKAGE_EXTRA ( order_item_id, source_package_extra_option_id, extra_type_snapshot, option_name_snapshot, option_value, additional_price ) VALUES ( #{orderItemId}, #{sourcePackageExtraOptionId}, #{extraTypeSnapshot}, #{optionNameSnapshot}, #{optionValue}, #{additionalPrice} )
mapper.update: UPDATE PRODUCT SET stock_quantity = IF(stock_quantity >= #{deductQty}, stock_quantity - #{deductQty}, stock_quantity), product_status = CASE WHEN stock_quantity = #{deductQty} THEN 'SOLD_OUT' ELSE product_status END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND product_status = 'SELLING' AND stock_quantity >= #{deductQty}

UPDATE PRODUCT SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity + #{restoreQty}, product_status = CASE WHEN product_status = 'SOLD_OUT' THEN 'SELLING' ELSE product_status END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT order_id AS orderId, order_number AS orderNumber, recipient_name AS recipientName, recipient_phone AS recipientPhone, postal_code AS postalCode, address_default AS addressDefault, IFNULL(address_detail, '') AS addressDetail, total_product_amount AS totalProductAmount, total_additional_amount AS totalAdditionalAmount, discount_amount AS discountAmount, used_point AS usedPoint, shipping_fee AS shippingFee, final_amount AS finalAmount, order_status AS orderStatus, DATE_FORMAT(ordered_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS orderedAt FROM ORDERS WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY order_id DESC

SELECT order_id AS orderId, member_id AS memberId, order_number AS orderNumber, recipient_name AS recipientName, recipient_phone AS recipientPhone, postal_code AS postalCode, address_default AS addressDefault, IFNULL(address_detail, '') AS addressDetail, total_product_amount AS totalProductAmount, total_additional_amount AS totalAdditionalAmount, discount_amount AS discountAmount, used_point AS usedPoint, shipping_fee AS shippingFee, final_amount AS finalAmount, order_status AS orderStatus, DATE_FORMAT(ordered_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS orderedAt FROM ORDERS WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT OI.order_item_id AS orderItemId, OI.order_id AS orderId, OI.product_id AS productId, OI.package_id AS packageId, CASE WHEN OI.product_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'PRODUCT' ELSE 'PACKAGE' END AS itemType, OI.item_name_snapshot AS itemNameSnapshot, OI.unit_price AS unitPrice, OI.quantity AS quantity, OI.line_amount AS lineAmount, CASE WHEN OI.product_id IS NOT NULL THEN ( SELECT PI.image_url FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.product_id = OI.product_id AND PI.image_type = 'THUMBNAIL' ORDER BY PI.display_order ASC, PI.image_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) ELSE ( SELECT PKI.image_url FROM PACKAGE_IMAGE PKI WHERE PKI.package_id = OI.package_id AND PKI.image_type = 'THUMBNAIL' ORDER BY PKI.display_order ASC, PKI.image_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) END AS thumbnailUrl FROM ORDER_ITEM OI WHERE OI.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY OI.order_item_id ASC

SELECT order_package_item_id AS orderPackageItemId, order_item_id AS orderItemId, source_package_item_id AS sourcePackageItemId, product_id AS productId, product_name_snapshot AS productNameSnapshot, item_role AS itemRole, quantity AS quantity, additional_price AS additionalPrice FROM ORDER_PACKAGE_ITEM WHERE order_item_id = #{orderItemId} ORDER BY order_package_item_id ASC

SELECT order_package_extra_id AS orderPackageExtraId, order_item_id AS orderItemId, extra_type_snapshot AS extraTypeSnapshot, option_name_snapshot AS optionNameSnapshot, IFNULL(option_value, '') AS optionValue, additional_price AS additionalPrice FROM ORDER_PACKAGE_EXTRA WHERE order_item_id = #{orderItemId} ORDER BY order_package_extra_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ORDER_CANCEL ( order_id, cancel_reason, cancel_status, cancel_amount, created_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{cancelReason}, #{cancelStatus}, #{cancelAmount}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT cancel_id AS cancelId, cancel_reason AS cancelReason, cancel_status AS cancelStatus, cancel_amount AS cancelAmount, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM ORDER_CANCEL WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY cancel_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT payment_id AS paymentId, payment_key AS paymentKey, payment_method AS payMethod, payment_amount AS paidAmount, payment_status AS paymentStatus, DATE_FORMAT(paid_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS paidAt FROM PAYMENT WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY payment_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `RETURN` ( order_id, product_id, member_id, return_reason, return_content, return_status, refund_amount, return_quantity, refund_status, requested_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{productId}, #{memberId}, #{returnReason}, #{returnContent}, 'REQUESTED', #{refundAmount}, #{returnQuantity}, 'WAITING', NOW(), NOW() )

INSERT INTO REFUND ( return_id, order_id, member_id, refund_amount, refund_method, refund_status, refund_reason, requested_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{returnId}, #{orderId}, #{memberId}, #{refundAmount}, #{refundMethod}, 'WAITING', #{refundReason}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE `RETURN` R INNER JOIN REFUND RF ON RF.return_id = R.return_id SET R.return_status = 'COMPLETED', R.refund_status = 'COMPLETED', R.admin_id = #{adminId}, R.processed_at = NOW(), R.updated_at = NOW(), RF.refund_status = 'COMPLETED', RF.admin_id = #{adminId}, RF.refund_content = #{refundContent}, RF.processed_at = NOW(), RF.updated_at = NOW() WHERE R.return_id = #{returnId}
mapper.select: SELECT R.return_id AS returnId, R.order_id AS orderId, R.product_id AS productId, PR.product_name AS productName, R.return_reason AS returnReason, IFNULL(R.return_content, '') AS returnContent, R.return_status AS returnStatus, R.return_quantity AS returnQuantity, IFNULL(RF.refund_id, 0) AS refundId, IFNULL(RF.refund_amount, R.refund_amount) AS refundAmount, IFNULL(RF.refund_method, 'CARD') AS refundMethod, IFNULL(RF.refund_status, R.refund_status) AS refundStatus, IFNULL(RF.refund_content, '') AS refundContent, DATE_FORMAT(R.requested_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS requestedAt, DATE_FORMAT(IFNULL(RF.processed_at, R.processed_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS processedAt FROM `RETURN` R INNER JOIN PRODUCT PR ON R.product_id = PR.product_id LEFT JOIN REFUND RF ON RF.return_id = R.return_id WHERE R.return_id = #{returnId} AND R.member_id = #{memberId}

SELECT P.product_id AS productId, NULL AS packageId, 1 AS quantity, 'PRODUCT' AS itemType, P.product_name AS itemName, P.price AS basePrice, P.product_status AS itemStatus, P.stock_quantity AS stockQuantity, NULL AS packageGrade, ( SELECT PI.image_url FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE PI WHERE PI.product_id = P.product_id AND PI.image_type = 'THUMBNAIL' ORDER BY PI.display_order ASC, PI.image_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumbnailUrl FROM PRODUCT P WHERE P.product_id = #{productId}

SELECT PK.package_id AS packageId, NULL AS productId, 1 AS quantity, 'PACKAGE' AS itemType, PK.package_name AS itemName, PK.package_price AS basePrice, PK.package_status AS itemStatus, NULL AS stockQuantity, PK.package_grade AS packageGrade, ( SELECT PKI.image_url FROM PACKAGE_IMAGE PKI WHERE PKI.package_id = PK.package_id AND PKI.image_type = 'THUMBNAIL' ORDER BY PKI.display_order ASC, PKI.image_id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumbnailUrl FROM PACKAGE PK WHERE PK.package_id = #{packageId}

SELECT PI.package_item_id AS packageItemId, PI.product_id AS defaultProductId, #{selectedProductId} AS selectedProductId, PI.item_role AS itemRole, PI.quantity AS itemQuantity, P.product_name AS selectedProductName, P.product_status AS selectedProductStatus, P.stock_quantity AS selectedProductStock, CASE WHEN PI.product_id = #{selectedProductId} THEN 0 ELSE PIO.additional_price END AS additionalPrice FROM PACKAGE_ITEM PI INNER JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.product_id = #{selectedProductId} INNER JOIN PACKAGE PK ON PK.package_id = PI.package_id LEFT JOIN PACKAGE_ITEM_OPTION PIO ON PIO.package_item_id = PI.package_item_id AND PIO.option_product_id = #{selectedProductId} WHERE PI.package_item_id = #{packageItemId} AND PK.package_id = #{packageId} AND ( PI.product_id = #{selectedProductId} OR PIO.package_item_option_id IS NOT NULL )

SELECT PEO.package_extra_option_id AS packageExtraOptionId, PE.package_extra_id AS packageExtraId, PE.extra_type AS extraType, PE.extra_name AS extraName, PEO.option_name AS optionName, PEO.additional_price AS additionalPrice FROM PACKAGE_EXTRA PE INNER JOIN PACKAGE_EXTRA_OPTION PEO ON PE.package_extra_id = PEO.package_extra_id WHERE PE.package_id = #{packageId} AND PEO.package_extra_option_id = #{packageExtraOptionId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PACKAGE_EXTRA WHERE package_id = #{packageId} AND is_required = 1
